inputs.text: [excited] MY… ah… SOR… ah. [curious] In Greek, "maia" means good mother, nursemaid. And "saura" is lizard, in the feminine.
[happily] Exactly. [warmly] She lived in the United States, in Montana, seventy-six million years ago.
[curious] Why do they call her that, "good mother"?
[gently] Because scientists found her nests, full of eggs and babies. [serious] Daspletosaurus hunted the young ones; [nervous] the little Troodon would sometimes come steal eggs.
